body:
Resolve process group leak in MCP server:
1. Update server.mjs to spawn agb CLI processes with 'detached: true'.
2. Modify handleCancelNotification and cleanup to send SIGTERM to the process group (-child.pid) instead of just the parent PID.
3. Ensure integration tests pass cleanly.
title: bugfix(mcp): spawn agb in a detached process group and kill entire process tree on cancel
